0022600196.text: The 76ers (8-1) come in on a five-game winning streak, 4-0 on the road, and sit 1st in the Atlantic and 1st in the East, while the Bulls (1-7) are on a six-game losing streak and sit 14th in the East. Philadelphia is missing Adem Bona (out, back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and Chicago is without Nic Claxton (out, hamstring strain) while Jalen Smith (hand) and Zach Collins (illness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The 76ers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 126-107 win in Philadelphia on November 2, 2026, and they lost 1-2 to the Bulls in 2025-26.
